title: Merguez Biryani with Caramelised Onions
meta_description: Merguez biryani layers spiced lamb sausage with long-grain basmati and deep-mahogany onions. A French-Pakistani fusion that earns its place at the table.
og_title: Merguez Biryani: Lahori Layers, French Sausage
og_description: What happens when Lahori dum technique meets North African merguez? A biryani with sausage sliced into coins, caramelised onions, and rice that smells like both continents at once.

image_briefs.prompt: Overhead wide shot of a Dutch oven just opened at the table, revealing golden-saffron-tinted basmati rice with vivid green herb flecks and the orange-red merguez coins visible where the rice has been parted. Steam rising. Dark wooden table. Natural afternoon window light. Slightly editorial, not staged.
image_briefs.alt: Merguez biryani in a Dutch oven, saffron rice parted to reveal spiced lamb sausage coins and caramelised onions

image_briefs.prompt: Flat lay of raw merguez sausages, a bowl of soaked basmati rice, sliced onions, small bowls of cumin, paprika, cinnamon, cardamom pods, a pinch of saffron in warm milk, fresh mint and coriander. Clean linen surface, natural light, nothing styled beyond being arranged clearly.
image_briefs.alt: Ingredients for merguez biryani including halal merguez sausages, basmati rice, whole spices, saffron, and fresh herbs

image_briefs.prompt: Close-up of sliced merguez coins searing hard in a cast-iron Dutch oven, cut faces darkly caramelised, orange-red fat pooling around them. High contrast, slightly dramatic, real cooking light.
image_briefs.alt: Merguez sausage coins searing in a Dutch oven, building the base for merguez biryani

image_briefs.prompt: A wide shallow bowl holding a generous portion of merguez biryani — two-toned rice, white and saffron-gold, with dark-edged sausage coins and wisps of mint visible. A small pot of cucumber raita alongside. Daylight from one side. Calm, confident composition.
image_briefs.alt: Plated merguez biryani with saffron rice, lamb sausage coins, and a side of cucumber raita
